title: Free AI Technical Analysis & Charting Tools I Built for Crypto Traders (Looking for Feedback)
author: jackofall1232
selftext: Hey everyone, ​Like many of you, I got tired of paying massive monthly subscription fees just to access clean charting indicators and reliable technical analysis tools. ​Over the last year, I’ve been building and refining cryptonerd.net—a completely free platform dedicated to crypto TA tools, automated chart breakdowns, and educational guides for traders looking to sharpen their setups. ​What’s currently available on the site: ​Interactive TA Tools: Free indicators and pattern recognition overlays. ​Educational Breakdowns: Clear guides on moving averages, volume profiles, and market structure. ​CryptoNerd AI Bot: Integrated tools to help break down price action. ​Everything on the site is 100% free to use with no hidden paywalls. I’d love for you to check it out, test the tools on your favorite altcoin charts, and let me know what features or indicators you'd want added next!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the automated chart breakdowns worry me more than the free indicators. does the bot say where its read is wrong, a level that kills the call? without that it's a forecast nobody can check afterwards.

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
Traders have seen a lot of free AI chart tools, so the CryptoNerd AI Bot will be judged on one worked example: a named pair and timeframe, the bot's breakdown, and which indicators it used. Posting that instead of the feature list gives people something to check against their own charts. Saying briefly how a site with no paywalls is funded also answers the first suspicious comment before it's written. For feature ideas, asking which indicator they currently pay for elsewhere will get sharper answers than an open request.
